headline: Monster Energy Athletes Claim Victory and Podium Spots on Day 1 of X Games New Orleans 2026
summary: Big first day in The Big Easy! Monster Energy congratulates its team of action sports athletes on a strong performance on the first day of X Games New Orleans 2026. On Friday, Monster Energy riders claimed a total of five medals (one gold, four bronze) across four contest events at legendary Caesars Superdome in New Orleans.
